title: Scheduled credits run manifest
description: The registration input of one scheduled credits run (report section 4.1). Register-CreditsRun.ps1 validates it and imports it into the store. Every path is an absolute local path: no UNC path, no relative path and no '..' segment.

project_root.description: The main tree of the project.

plan_folder.description: The plan folder, relative to project_root.

brief.description: The prompt file of the run.

segment_cap_usd.description: May be omitted only under token_budgets "off" in the project_root's .agent/review-limits.json; credits_state.py refuses the omission otherwise.

auth.description: How the CLI signs in. Absent means key. subscription is the fleet member route: an S4U task, no key file, and the subscription token in the CLI's environment only.

allowed_tools.description: Tools allowed without a prompt, in the dispatch wrapper's -AllowedTools form.

gate_project.description: The project of the M-1 receipt when it is not the project_root. Only with auth subscription: a member gates once in a fixed empty folder.

max_budget_usd.description: The CLI's own budget stop of each segment, when it is below the reservation. The reservation and the cap rules stay. Register-CreditsRun.ps1 refuses a value above a given segment_cap_usd (max_budget_above_cap).

env.description: Extra environment names for the CLI: at most 32 names, each AGENT_MODEL_REGISTRY_HOME or {{PROJECT_NAME_UPPER}}_[A-Z0-9_]+ and not a refused name, each value a string of at most 1024 characters with no NUL, CR or LF. Checked at registration and at each launch (env_name_refused, env_value_refused).

run_cap_usd.description: May be omitted only under token_budgets "off" (see launch.segment_cap_usd).

phases.description: The run-parameters phases of the run, in order (report section 4.4). A run with phases is admitted through run_parameters.py inspect and bind --pending, and resumes per its suspended phase state. A run without it is a legacy run.

executor_worktree.description: The run works in an executor worktree at the base B that admission binds (report section 5.4).

carry_allowed.description: Repository-relative files or folders (a folder ends with '/') that the worktree may carry as successor inputs. Needs executor_worktree.

quote.description: The user's own chat words that name the runs, their order and the cap.

chain_cap_usd.description: May be omitted only under token_budgets "off" (see launch.segment_cap_usd).

session.description: The chat session of the typed message that set up the chain.

message_uuid.description: The typed message whose whole text is the quote.
